detail.longDescription: I created a file minimal.h : int my_function(void); I converted it to Rust: bindgen.exe minimal.h -o minimal.rs and got as expected: unsafe extern "C" { pub fn my_function() -> ::std::os::raw::c_int; } Then I tried to convert it to Rust for building .wasm file to be interpreted by command line tool wasm3: bindgen.exe minimal.h -o minimal_wasm.rs -- --target=wasm32-wasip1 but got an empty file. Function my_function was just ignored. I tried to use clang from WASI SDK with proper sysroot , collected debug log, but it seems that it happens by design. However, I managed to build .wasm file to be interpreted by wasm3 (some SQLite test) from C source, and it works. Looks like Rust provides less capabilities than C. Why?
